flavorText: It's so popular with the elderly that there's a magazine devoted to this Pokémon. Fans obsess over the particular length and angle of its arms.

flavorText: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

abilities.textKo: 자신의 차례에 1번(기술을 사용하기 전에), 이 포켓몬이 벤치에 있다면 사용할 수 있다. 상대에게 배틀 포켓몬을 벤치 포켓몬과 교체하게 한다. 그 경우 이 포켓몬에게 붙어 있는 모든 카드를 트래쉬하고 이 포켓몬을 자신의 덱 아래에 놓는다.

flavorText: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

attacks.name: Full Blitz
attacks.text: Search your deck for up to 3 Lightning Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokemon. Then, shuffle your deck.

attacks.name: Tag Bolt-GX
attacks.text: If this Pokemon has at least 3 extra Lightning Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack's cost), this attack does 170 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokemon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokemon.) (You can't use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)
